HOW TO PLAY

1

Clone / Duplicate (1 Step)Green Ring

Click one of your gems and select an adjacent hex (1 step). A brand new gem duplicates onto the target while keeping your original piece intact.

2

Jump / Leap (2 Steps)Amber Ring

Leap across two spaces to reach tactical positions. Jumping moves the original gem across the board, leaving your starting tile empty.

3

Touch Conversion / InfectionInfection Wave

Whenever your gem lands next to enemy pieces, all adjacent enemy gems immediately convert to your side in a chain reaction!

4

Victory Condition

The match concludes when all board tiles are occupied or an opponent has no remaining pieces. The player controlling the most gems wins!

⚡
TACTICAL PLAYBOOK

Grandmaster Strategies & Pro Tips

Mastering hexagonal geometry requires spatial awareness and balancing territory growth (cloning) against aggressive leaps (jumping).

DEFENSE

Edge & Corner Anchoring

Hexes on outer perimeters have only 3 to 4 neighbors compared to 6 in the interior. Anchoring along edges prevents opponents from surrounding your gems.

CAUTION

Beware the Reckless Jump

Leaping into open territory leaves an isolated piece exposed to counter-attacks. Prefer cloning unless a jump gives a massive 3+ piece conversion swing.

CONTROL

Choke Points & Bridges

In maps like Donut Void or Hourglass, controlling narrow bridges cuts off opponent expansion, forcing them to leap blindly into your traps.

ENDGAME

Chain Conversions

When the board is nearly full, single moves can convert up to 6 adjacent hexes at once. Calculate ahead to ensure your moves cannot be counter-captured.

GAME HERITAGE

About Hex Board Game

Online Hex Board Game is a modern recreation of the legendary 1993 board game Hexxagon, originally created by Software Creations.

Key Features:
  • Pure SVG Axial Vector Geometry & 60 FPS Game Engine
  • Hardware-Accelerated Web Audio Engine
  • Minimax AI with Alpha-Beta Pruning
  • Interactive Step-by-Step Tutorial & Practice Arena
